decision.title: XSLT conformance sweep: XSLT coercion casts, globals in xsl:iterate, deep-copy types, fixed-namespaces documents (packet 4.29)

body.p: , after , , , , , , . Verified as asks: the debug preset (the xslt, ir, evaluator, json, function_library, serialize, cli/transform tests touched), clang-tidy on the changed files, the call-cycle check, the book examples (, 399 match; no CLI output the book shows changed), and the whole XT40 suite with the release driver after each change, case by case. XT40 12,250 to 12,261 passed (104 to 99 wrong error), 268 to 257 failed, 0 errors, no case lost, from a whole run at b97d939 (with 2.26's and 5.16's commits as they landed). Commits 86ad244, 240bb83, a6ec5ad, 4c7a872, 368f0e0, eb27ee8.

item.p: A failed cast in an XSLT binding's coercion ('s open item, 9.3: a value that "cannot be converted to the required type" is a type error): a new IR coercion role, SXML_IR_COERCION_ROLE_XSLT_BINDING, for the coercions whose XSLT lowering maps XPTY0004 to its own code (variables, explicit parameter defaults, template and function results, xsl:global-context-item); for it and TEMPLATE_PARAMETER the evaluator's coercion reports its type error where the cast of an untyped atomic item fails, not FORG0001. Only the coercion's own cast changes, so a FORG0001 of a lazily evaluated value stays ('s concern). 's reading (FORG0001 as the draft's) is replaced: the coercion rules cast (XPath 4.0, 3.4.3), and XSLT says what a failure to convert is (as-1602, sequence-0132, variable-0115, call-template-ext-2102).

Globals in xsl:iterate: the closure captured every declared global by value, so an xsl:iterate in a global's initializer read that global while it was being computed (XTDE0640) and computed every other global first; globals are captured as GLOBAL_VARIABLE atoms and read where the closure reads them, as does for inline functions (arrays-306, si-iterate-099).

Smaller fixes: xsl:copy-of with copy-accumulators="yes" links the validated copies (19.10); XTTE0945 for xsl:copy in a global whose global context item is absent at run time (11.9.1; glob-cxt-item-013); fn:xml-to-json's indent option indents (F&O 4.0, 17.4.7; a request flag of the JSON writer); on-no-match="deep-copy" copies with validation="preserve" (6.10.2; shallow-copy unchanged, its xsl:copy rebuilds the element); fixed-namespaces URI tokens read the document's outermost in-scope namespaces through the module resolver (3.6.1); function-available sees current-group and the other context functions (24.1); elements with simple content keep their whitespace (4.2.2).

The draft decides, left (; recorded before or found now): "~T" patterns (53, ); priorities and pattern forms (9, ); exact numeric comparison (sx-gc-eq-*, sx-if-213); XPath 4.0's merged codes XPTY0019/0020 into XPTY0004 (5), array:members returning JNodes (for-each-array-001 to -003), XTTE0505 for mode/@as (mode-4007, -4013; mode-4014 coerces <blue>12</blue> to 12, so no error at all), xs:dateTimeStamp built in (type-available-0151), XTSE3155 and XTSE0800 not in the draft, xs:numeric under 1.0 compatibility (), 's and 's lists: 43 cases of codes and functions, 112 in all.

Suite errors and environment (42): whitespace-only assert-xml (sf-snapshot-0201 to -0209, use-package-170 to -173, accumulator-054, attribute-set-1508/-1509, on-non-empty-004/-005); accumulator-073 (no use-accumulators on the initial mode, so 19.2 makes the accumulator inapplicable: XTDE3362); function-lookup-005, static-027 (spec unclear), package-location-001 to -005, next-match-017, function-40-012; Saxon collection URIs (merge-097*), the network (unparsed-text-2003), implementation limits (date-094e/f, -095e/f), try-034 (recovery is implementation-dependent).

Left, real gaps (about 130 failed, 72 wrong error), with sizes: error codes of xsl:evaluate's untrusted and module cases (12, small); package and override static codes (about 20, small each); schema-aware validation codes and source ENTITY checks (about 20, medium); streaming (about 20, medium to large); records and type aliases (12, XPath coercion to record types: discarding undefined entries, medium); fn:document per package strip-space, fragment identifiers of xsl:source-document, strip-space "none" (; medium); serialization details (about 10, small each); deterministic functions, new-each-time="no" (function-1025/-1026, a memo of results, medium); split-when and merge-when (2, medium); xsl:copy of map JNodes in the shallow-copy rule (mode-4031: the draft's 11.9.1.2 note and its 6.10.3 example disagree, and self::element() selects JNodes in sxml's XPath, XPath 4.0 4.7.5.5); inherit-namespaces="no" needs namespace undeclarations in the tree (namespace-2606, a substrate change); copy-4308 (a template called from a global reads the absent focus at the call); map-for-key with an empty $top and decimal keys (2, small); fn:function-lookup per package (function-lookup-004, medium); 6.11's current rule in an attribute set invoked inside xsl:for-each (, an evaluator operation, no suite case).
The XT40 section of docs/CONFORMANCE.md was not regenerated.
